title: Moderate winds expected countrywide – stay alert
summary: Moderate easterly to southeasterly winds with speeds of 13 to 24 km/h are expected countrywide from 13th to 17th October 2026. This will result in windy conditions across all areas. The public is advised to stay alert and secure loose property
